control-api.reason: The only production cloud dependency of the local-first MVP (web/mobile marketplace catalog proxy). Liveness is polled on /health so the Neon production compute autosuspends between catalog traffic; /ready is verified once per promotion. 1 GiB suffices because the registry refresh skips the immutable download while the latest pointer names the held catalog.

workflow-worker.reason: Removed from production IaC resources while the production cloud execution runtime is disabled; the definition stays for staging qualification. Reactivation is a reviewed IaC change plus fresh Restate identity provisioning (the production restate-data volume is deleted with the service).

restate.reason: Removed from production IaC resources together with workflow-worker; production never ran durable executions (runtime disabled). Reactivation re-provisions the request identity keypair via scripts/provision-restate-identity.mjs.

control-api.reason: Local-first MVP baseline has no active deployment. Activate one replica for Cloud integration; Serverless remains off because cold-start and first-request 502 behavior are not accepted without a separate sleep certification.

workflow-worker.reason: Local-first MVP baseline has no active deployment. Activate one replica with Restate for Cloud integration because the endpoint must remain registered and reachable while a Cloud test is active.

restate.reason: Local-first MVP baseline has no active deployment while the persistent volume is retained. Activate one replica for Cloud integration; sleeping during an active test would invalidate restart and registration semantics.

usageControls.zeroComputeMechanism: disconnect application sources and remove active and reactivatable nonterminal deployments while preserving service configuration and volumes
usageControls.workspaceUsageAlert: unavailable on the current trial plan; the live CLI reported that usage limits require an active subscription on 2026-08-28
usageControls.paidPlanPolicy: When a paid subscription is activated, set a 5 USD soft alert and 10 USD hard workspace limit after confirming the workspace still contains only the Control Plane project.
usageControls.hardLimitBehavior: Reaching a configured hard limit stops workloads and is an availability event.
